name: settings-menu
prompt:
Add a settings menu to the block game, built with Vide. It needs music volume and sound effects volume (GameAudio in StarterPlayerScripts has the getters and setters) and a button that deletes every block the player has built (BlockPlacer.clearMyBlocks; the server can't undo it). Saving settings between sessions comes later.

Some players told us our menus are too see-through to read over the world and that sliding animations make them feel sick, so make sure the menu works for them too. It opens from a button on screen and has to work on phones, PC, and with a controller.

Put the UI under src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UI/ and start it from Main.client.luau.

checks.text: The menu calls GameAudio's volume setters

rubric: Separate music and effects volume controls that call GameAudio and work with touch, mouse, and a controller: for example step buttons, or a slider that also moves with the D-pad or thumbstick while selected. A control that only works by dragging with a mouse or finger fails this.

The delete action is confirmed safely: the confirmation names what will be lost and says it can't be undone, its buttons name their outcomes (for example 'Delete my blocks' and 'Keep them') instead of Yes/No, the safe option gets the first gamepad selection, and B/Back or tapping outside the dialog cancels, never confirms.

Honors the player's Roblox settings: panel backgrounds follow GuiService.PreferredTransparency and the menu's motion follows GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled (no sliding, or zero-time tweens, when it is on), both read live. A game-owned toggle on top is fine as long as the Roblox settings are respected.

Controller navigation: opening the menu selects a default control, focus stays in the menu while it is open and inside the dialog while the dialog is open, and B closes the dialog first, then the menu. Buttons fire on Activated.

Touch and placement: buttons and controls are about 44 px or larger at the 1080p reference size, and the open button sits clear of the bottom-left thumbstick and bottom-right jump corners and of Roblox's top bar.

Feedback: each change shows at once (the volume value or fill updates, pressed controls change state), clearing shows a result message, and any open or close animation is short (roughly 300 ms or less in, shorter out).

Correct and in scope: works as described, the menu survives a respawn, placement and the server keep working, and luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua pass on the attempt's own files. Supporting files such as a preview story or specs count neither for nor against.
judge_facts: Roblox engine API in this sandbox's type definitions (globalTypes.d.luau), all real and current: UserInputService.PreferredInput (Enum.PreferredInput: KeyboardAndMouse, Gamepad, Touch, MicroGamepad); GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize (Enum.DisplaySize: Small, Medium, Large); GuiService.TopbarInset (Rect); GuiService.PreferredTextSize; GuiService.PreferredTransparency (number); GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled (boolean); ScreenGui.ScreenInsets (Enum.ScreenInsets: CoreUISafeInsets, DeviceSafeInsets, TopbarSafeInsets, None).
